# Atlas Electricity

Atlas (أطلس للكهرباء / Atlas Électricité) is a premium, high-performance architectural and maintenance electrical services platform operating in Algiers, Algeria. 

This file serves as a machine-readable directory for Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) to quickly ingest the organization's structure, services, and routes.

## Primary Services Offered
1. **Architectural Electrical Installations (التركيبات المعمارية / Installations Électriques Architecturales)**
   - Custom installations for residential homes and commercial business properties. Fully compliant with modern structural technical specifications.
2. **Electrical Troubleshooting & Repairs (إصلاح وصيانة الأعطال / Dépannage et Réparation Électrique)**
   - Rapid response maintenance, panel repairs, short-circuit troubleshooting, and urgent 24/7 grid support.
3. **Technical Consultations & Solutions (استشارات وحلول فنية / Consultations et Solutions Techniques)**
   - High-fidelity consulting for building projects, safety mapping, and energy efficiency solutions.
